Job Description

Are you dedicated to building robust, innovative solutions and motivated to assist in shaping the future of modern banking? Then join our Customer Relationship squad at Danske Bank!

The Customer Relationship squad is responsible for the data and core capabilities of the relationship between a customer and subsidiaries of the Danske Bank Group.

You will work closely with the team and the Product Owner to align with stakeholders and ensure a seamless customer journey, and you will be part of a modernization at the very core of the bank.

We are looking for a Senior Java Software Engineer who enjoys translating business needs into scalable and secure technical solutions. As a squad, we are exploring how AI agents and tools can enhance our development processes, ways of working and the value we deliver. You will help shape this journey by turning promising ideas into practical improvements for the team.

Working closely with your colleagues, you will contribute throughout the development lifecycle – from understanding and refining requirements to implementation, testing, deployment and ongoing support – with efficiency and quality at the heart of everything we do.

You will

• Contribute to solutions throughout the development lifecycle, from design and implementation to deployment and handover to end users.

• Apply your experience to solve complex technical challenges, share knowledge and support colleagues in delivering strong outcomes.

• Ensure high-quality code by applying sound engineering practices and writing automated tests.

• Help us move towards event- and API-focused, cloud-hosted solutions where data consumer self-service is the way forward.

• Operate within a self-organising Scrum team, applying an agile mindset.

• Support, maintain and modernise existing solutions.

• Use AI-assisted development tools to improve productivity and quality and help the team explore and adopt valuable AI solutions.

What we are looking for

• Strong proficiency in Java and its supporting development tools.

• Hands-on experience designing, developing and testing modern software solutions; experience with cloud-native systems is an advantage.

• Professional English communication skills.

• A proactive and collaborative approach to working within and across teams.

• An interest in improving engineering practices and sharing knowledge with colleagues.

• Good understanding of DevOps and CI/CD tools, such as Azure DevOps, GitHub Actions or Jenkins.

• Hands-on experience using AI as part of software development and a strong focus on identifying, testing and championing AI solutions within the team

• A team-oriented mindset and the ability to communicate clearly about technical decisions and solutions.

Your benefits

As a modern workplace, we offer our employees a canteen, rooftop terrace, regular social and professional events, a very attractive benefits package including health and accident insurance, pension, and many other perks. You will also get 6 weeks of vacation and 5 extra care days annually and be part of a flexible work environment. We expect you to be working minimum 3-4 days per week from our office in Copenhagen.

Sounds interesting?

We will start conducting interviews in November, and application deadline is Monday 9th of November. If you have any questions or would like more information about the role, you are welcome to contact IT Chapter Lead Brian Skou Hansen at briah@danskebank.dk.

About Us

Danske Bank is a Nordic bank with bridges to the world around us. For 150 years, we have supported people and businesses in releasing their potential. A career with us is an opportunity to join a community of 22,000 colleagues in a culture where we are committed to Teaming Up, Owning It and Being Open. Together, we are on a journey to transform Danske Bank into a better bank. For our customers, our employees and the societies around us.

Would you like to help young people and educators take action for the environment? Are you motivated by data-driven communication, youth-focused education, and contributing to projects with real-world impact?

The Foundation for Environmental Education (FEE) is seeking an Education Programme Intern (Eco-Schools & Eco-Campus) to assist with the development of high-quality educational resources, strengthen our digital presence, and support our global FEE network. In this internship, you’ll build competencies in communication, storytelling, stakeholder engagement, and applied sustainability practices.

As our Eco-Schools & Eco-Campus Intern, you will engage with topics related to Education for Sustainable Development (ESD). You will learn about the Eco-Schools/Eco-Campus Seven Steps Methodology and the whole-system approach, which integrate sustainable practices into operations, governance, curricula, and teaching and learning, while encouraging students, educators, staff, and leadership to drive meaningful change.

You will support the dissemination of good practices from participating schools and institutions, contribute to the development of educational and communication materials, and support ongoing programme activities, such as the Teacher Award and the Lesson Plan Competition.

ABOUT FEE

The Foundation for Environmental Education (FEE) is one of the world’s largest environmental education organisations, with members in over 85 countries. Through our global network and our six programmes: Blue Flag, Green Key, Eco-Campus, Eco-Schools, Learning about Ecosystems & Forests (LEAF), and Young Reporters for the Environment (YRE), we empower people to take meaningful environmental action and promote Education for Sustainable Development (ESD).

The Foundation for Environmental Education’s Head Office is based in Copenhagen, Denmark, and currently brings together individuals from a diverse range of nationalities and backgrounds.

FEE is committed to fostering a culture of belonging, inclusion, and environmental justice within our network and in all our communications.

RESPONSIBILITIES

As an intern, you will be part of our dynamic team and contribute to a variety of projects and activities. Depending on your profile and interests, your responsibilities may include:

• 
Support the design and development of educational materials, infographics, presentations, and other visual resources.

• 
Contribute to storytelling around greening education by creating engaging social media content and ensuring consistent messaging and branding across FEE platforms.

• 
Assist with visual content creation and website updates.

• 
Participate in the delivery of workshops, webinars, and educational events.

• 
Collaborate and communicate with international stakeholders across FEE's network.

• 
Help monitor and track the outreach, participation, and impact of programme activities and campaigns.

• 
Support ongoing research and projects related to Education for Sustainable Development (ESD).

NECESSARY SKILLS

• 
Currently pursuing or recently completed a degree in Environmental Studies, Sustainability, Education, Social Sciences, Communications, International Development, Journalism or a related field.

• 
Strong interest in environmental education and international non-profit work.

• 
Excellent written and spoken English communication skills.

• 
Experience in developing communication materials (e.g. newsletter, articles, brochure) and visual resources (e.g. social media graphics, infographics, and illustrations). This can include work developed through your studies, volunteering or personal projects.

• 
Experience with Canva is required.

• 
Familiarity with social media platforms, digital communication, and content creation.

• 
Organised, proactive, detail-oriented, and able to work independently and collaboratively.

DESIRABLE SKILLS

• 
Familiarity with website management and digital learning platforms.

Experience in developing educational resources, learning materials and creating engaging digital content.

• 
Proficiency in Microsoft Office, particularly Excel.

• 
Previous experience working or volunteering with an international non-profit organisation.

What you get in return:

At FEE, you’ll be learning from a global team committed to addressing some of today’s biggest environmental challenges. As a part of the Education team, you’ll have room to take initiative and bring your ideas to life. This internship offers a great learning experience in Education for Sustainable Development.

Learning Opportunities: Engage yourself in important topics and gain hands-on experience in a supportive environment.

Guidance and Mentorship: Receive valuable feedback and advice from our team of professionals.

Networking Exposure: Expand your professional network for future opportunities.

Meaningful Contribution: Be part of initiatives that create positive change.

APPLICATION PROCESS

Ready to embark on this enriching journey?

Please submit:

• 
Your CV

• 
A short motivation letter

• 
A sample of work you are particularly proud of. This could be a piece of writing, an educational resource, a visual design or another relevant project from your studies, volunteering or personal interests

Application deadline: 8 November 2026

Selection process

• 
Submit your application through this form.

• 
Shortlisted candidates will be invited for an interview via Teams/Zoom.

• 
Successful candidates will be contacted following the interview process.

We encourage applications from candidates of all backgrounds, identities, and nationalities, both from within and beyond the FEE network.

For questions about the internship, please contact recruitment@fee.global and include "Internship" in the subject line.

Internship terms and conditions

• 
Unpaid internship for a duration of a minimum of four months. It is encouraged that the internship is part of the internship requirements for students, but it can also be part of a post-studies internship.

• 
The intern will have to work 35 hours a week, including a 30 min lunch break.

• 
We are looking for someone that can start on 15 February 2027 and preferably stay until mid-August 2027.

• 
English is the official language at the FEE Head Office.

• 
The intern is an EU/EEA/Nordic citizen or have a valid work permit in Denmark.

• 
The intern will be working 50/50 from home and the FEE Head Office.

• 
The intern will need a social security number in Denmark (which means that the applicant must provide proof to the government that they have enough financial funds to sustain themselves (see: New to Denmark – EU Self-support).

• 
The intern must inform FEE about existing holiday plans in the internship period during the interview. Holidays during the internship are confirmed by the intern’s supervisor and should be announced two weeks in advance.

We value equality, diversity and inclusion in our workplace and encourage all applicants with a matching profile to apply for the position.

Imagine a future where you are a key part of our Asset Integrity Team operating some of Denmark’s most important infrastructure assets both onshore and offshore

Application deadline

15 Novemberr 2026 , 23:59 CET

Country Denmark

Location Gentofte, Skærbæk

Working hours Full-time

Employment type Permanent

Legal entity Infrastructure Assets

Some of our benefits include:

Proven very high employee satisfaction and motivation

Continuous development opportunities for all employees

Competitive salary, pension scheme, and attractive holiday package

A wide range of health benefits, such as health insurance, nutritious food, and fitness facilities in our office locations

Join us in this role where you’ll be responsible for onshore and offshore pipeline operation, inspection, engineering and integrity tasks as well as asset management of the Danish onshore and offshore pipelines and terminals bringing most of the Danish oil and gas into Denmark.

**Welcome to Asset Integrity

**You’ll be part of Asset Integrity where you, together with your engineering colleague will support the organisation with your mechanical engineering skills in the operation, inspection, engineering, integrity and asset management. As a team we foster collaboration and innovation. We are a group of ambitious professionals within different engineering disciplines, who are passionate and motivated and who value teamwork as an essential part of safeguarding our assets.

You’ll play an important role in:

• executing various engineering studies and tasks for onshore oil&gas terminals and offshore and onshore pipelines both internally and by defining scope of work and liaison with external engineering consultants

• performing inspection data analysis and integrity assessment of our approx 800km of pipelines

• supporting the  offshore inspection and maintenance campaigns.

• liaison with Authorities, Contractors, Oil&Gas companies and other third parties.

• act as offshore company representative/supervisor onboard contractors’ vessels

• ensure and perform engineering and quality check and final delivery of inspection results to our Integrity engineers

• providing input to budgets and reporting to management.

Once familiar with our systems, you will be included in a 24/7 duty roster to respond to emergency situations.

To succeed in the role, you:

• have key focus on safety, which shall be embedded in all the work you do;

• hold an engineering degree, preferably in mechanical engineering

• have experience working with oil&gas plant and pipeline integrity and engineering both onshore and  offshore

• have experience working with engineering companies, contractors and/or suppliers;

• have experience working with practical onshore and offshore pipeline operation and maintenance as well as experience in marine and subsea operations and inspection methods

• have a proactive and systematic approach to your work tasks

• possess strong analytical and problem-solving skills and can work independently in your area of responsibility and participate in a culture of knowledge sharing in an open, honest and  trustful culture

• are a team player who thrives on solving complex problems together with your colleagues.

• speak and write English fluently and knowledge with a Scandinavian language is an advantage.

Maybe you’ve read the above and can see you have some transferable skills, even though they don’t quite match all the points. If you think you can bring something to the team, we still encourage you to apply. You’ll receive the training needed to maintain and further develop your competencies.

The role involves some travel, including two to three day trips per month to onshore sites, a two-week offshore campaign in summer, and a few conferences or courses each year.

Working at Ørsted

In the Asset Integrity department we have the responsibility for looking after some of Denmark’s most important infrastructure assets. We have highly skilled employees dedicated to safeguard and care for our assets.

We offer a collaborative, dynamic, and diverse workplace with constructive feedback and continuous learning, enabling our people to develop their expertise in asset integrity and engineering.

Shape the future with us

Send your application to us as soon as possible. We’ll be conducting interviews on a continuous basis and reserve the right to take down the advert when we’ve found the right candidate.

As an applicant or employee, you may request reasonable work and position accommodation or adjustments via accommodation@orsted.com.

Please note that for your application to be taken into consideration, you must submit your application via our online career pages and answer the screening questions relevant for your country. We don't take applications or inquiries from external recruiters or agencies into account for this position.

**Position salary range:

**For this position, the expected base pay range is kr54,480.00- kr68,100.00 for the advertised location. The offered base salary will be determined within this range based on relevant skills, experience, and expected role fulfilment within the stated pay range to ensure a fair and competitive offer. Where applicable, you may also be eligible for variable payment and a comprehensive benefits package.

**Our benefits package:

**For this position, employees who meet eligibility requirements have access to: employer‑paid pension (11 % contribution), full insurance coverage (accident, life, critical illness, and health insurance); five weeks of paid holiday plus 10 additional paid days off per holiday year; a 3 % holiday allowance; access to Ørsted Life & Fitness Vitality including fitness classes, physiotherapy, massage, and well-being programmes; a multimedia package (mobile phone, PC, and internet); staff club membership with sport and cultural activities; and access to the company canteen (monthly lunch scheme or daily tickets).

**Pre-employment background check:

**This position requires a background check as part of the hiring process and the offer is dependent on the outcome of this check. You will receive more information during the recruitment process. Background checks are conducted by an external provider in accordance with local legal requirements.

Be a part of the data revolution in sports!

This is a great opportunity to join our growing Data Science and BI developer team. Our team is responsible for the development and operations of both our internal and customer-facing reporting and dashboard solutions, as well as our data science and machine learning products. We are focused on making our rich tracking data more actionable to customers as well as supporting our internal product development and operations with useful insights. We also use our data to develop data science and machine learning solutions that enhance our product experiences. In collaboration with our cutting-edge radar and computer vision-based tracking technology, we are building products used by the best athletes in the world.

Example projects we are working on:

• Reporting for environmental variations between stadium tracking locations based on athlete performance models and statistical analysis

• Dashboards for trends and detecting outliers in radar tracking and computer vision diagnostics across thousands of remote devices

• Translating ball tracking metrics into coaching-orientated measures to help amateur athletes improve their performance

• Supervised learning models to suggest both practice and gameplay recommendations to make our sophisticated products easier to use

• Vision-based person detection combined with predicting the position they play on the field for game strategy

Your Profile

You have hands-on experience working with data day to day in SQL and python, from the fundamentals of loading, ETL, and pipeline automation to answering ad-hoc questions from the business and operations teams. You have experience developing reports and dashboards to address the questions that are reoccurring. You are familiar with using a developer tool stack and operating in a scrum team. You also have experience using data science modelling techniques to derive next-level insight from data, as well as an appreciation for running machine learning in production. Your focus is on the practical outcome and value to the business of using data to inform everything we do. You like working in an international team across many cultures. You like sports.

Responsibilities

• Develop internal and customer-facing BI reports and dashboards

• Use dimensional modelling to develop database schemas and semantic layers

• Manage data warehouse data pipeline automation rules, ensure smooth operations

• Work with our Data Engineers to acquire and prepare working data, initial data cleaning, statistical analysis, and mining

• Interface with product owners, operations, and developers to refine requirements

• Identify and perform data science model selection, feature engineering, and tuning, develop an experiment based and evaluation workflow, package for production

Job requirements

• A strong educational background where coursework required heavy use of data and a scientific or engineering based workflows

• Experience with data processing, preparation, cleansing, and mining, in SQL and Python

• Experience developing dashboards and reports in a BI toolset

• Experience with applying data science and machine learning methods and move across a variety of unsupervised and supervised approaches, experience with NumPy, pandas, sci-kit learn

Working in a fast-paced, team-based environment also demands a certain degree of self-planning, as well as the ability to work independently. Your colleagues are highly skilled, innovative, and proactive in their work approach. They possess strong analytical skills, are good communicators in English, and take pride in their job and deliverables.

The Office

We are located at DTU Science Park in Hørsholm. We take great pride in the state-of-art building we have designed! The office features bright meeting rooms, coffee areas to catch up with colleagues, a large testing arena with simulators available for employees and a fitness center, everything surrounded by a beautiful forest and respecting the environment. We made sure to utilize the newest technologies to be energy efficient and be mindful of ventilation and sound propagation. The cherry on top is our canteen: with an indoor and outdoor area to enjoy the fresh food prepared by our own kitchen staff.

Our proprietary technology is based on expert knowledge about radar, computer vision, data, and software engineering. Our solutions are developed by specialists who endlessly explore and challenge new technical boundaries. Trackman’s blend of cutting-edge technology, sports, and continued growth make our company an outstanding place to work.

At Trackman, we use technology, data and innovation to transform the way sports are played, practiced and experienced around the world.

We are looking for a Senior Manager to lead and develop our People Operations function as we continue to grow globally. With more than 1,100 employees worldwide this is an opportunity to strengthen and scale the processes, governance, technology and employee experience that support our organisation. Working closely with the Head of HR and key stakeholders, you will play an important role in shaping a modern, efficient, and globally connected function.

Why this role is different

Trackman has grown into a global organisation through innovation, strong products and talented people. As we continue to scale, we are investing in the infrastructure, systems and ways of working needed to support our next phase of growth.

This role is ideal for someone who enjoys building as much as operating. You will lead People Operations, drive improvements across the employee lifecycle, and help shape how technology, automation and strong governance enable a better employee experience.

You'll join at a pivotal stage in our journey, with the opportunity to make a visible and lasting impact across our global organisation.

• 
Build a high-performing, service-oriented People Operations team with clear responsibilities and standards

• 
Ensure operational excellence across all employee lifecycle

• 
Create scalable ways of working that support future growth

Own and improve the Global Employee Lifecycle

• 
Design, manage and continuously improve processes covering onboarding, internal mobility, employment changes, promotions, leave management, international relocations and offboarding

• 
Standardized processes across regions while accommodating local requirements

•

8+ years of HR experience with Significant experience within People Operations, Shared Services or Employee Experience

• 
Experience leading and developing teams in an international organisation

• 
A strong track record of improving global HR processes, governance and service delivery models

• 
Strong understanding of HR systems, digitalization and automation

• 
Experience working across multiple jurisdictions and employment frameworks

• 
Strong project, stakeholder and change management skills

• 
Excellent analytical and structured approach, with excellent problem-solving and organisational skills

• 
A clear and scalable global People Operations model is established

•

• 
Governance, policies and operational decision-making are clearer across the organisation

jobs.occupation: Student Assistant as Administrative Assistant in Project Management Office at AU Herning
jobs.description:
The Project Management Office at AU Herning is looking for a student assistant to carry out various administration projects as they relate to various research projects, project administration, and course administration at AU Herning.

We are looking for a student assistant who can assist with the following tasks:

• Various administration tasks with the PMO team

• Administration work on different research grants, both within Denmark and the EU

• Daily administrative tasks using Microsoft Suite, Adobe, and other programs

• SOME management for international research projects

• Regular communication with international partners for research projects

• Regular administrative tasks such as data entry, data gathering, and testing interfaces.

• Assistant with planning and working events hosted by the department

Who we are looking for:

• You must be enrolled at AU Herning

• You must thrive in an environment where precision and accuracy is important, and you can stay focused and selfdirected on various tasks

• You have good analytical skills

• Have a good grasp on the English language

Who we are

BTECH is part of Aarhus BSS, Aarhus University – a top 100 university. Aarhus BSS has achieved the triple-crown AASCB, AMBA and EQUIS accreditations.

BTECH is located in the business-oriented and entrepreneurial city of Herning. The department excels in business, IT and engineering disciplines and emphasises the importance of company collaborations. We have around 1,200 students and close to 100 academic staff members. Each year, approximately 500 students are involved in company projects in more than 250 companies ranging from SMEs to leading multinationals. Our incubator Business Factory launches 10 new companies each year.

We influence society through business development and technology. For this reason, many research projects are conducted in close collaboration with industry on the basis of new data and new technologies. These projects are generously supported by the ERC, Horizon Europe, the Independent Research Fund Denmark and the Danish Industry Foundation, among others.

More information about BTECH is available here.

Further information

For further information about the position and the department, please contact Emily Tynes: tel. +45 4189 3353; email emily@btech.au.dk

If you need help uploading your application or have any questions about the recruitment process, please contact HR Supporter, Charlotte Thomsen, tel.: +45 8716 5362; email: charlotte@au.dk.

Practical information

Starting date as soon as possible and no later than 1 December 2025.

The average number of working hours is 8 hours weekly.

The place of work is Birk Centerpark 15, 7400 Herning

It is a permanent position which means for as long as you are a student.

Application deadline

15 November 2026

Application

If you are interested in applying for the position, please send:

• A short motivated application

• CV

Are you ready to shape the tax function of an international shipping company?

Clipper is enhancing its internal tax capability as part of a continued focus on strengthening governance and decision support across the organisation. We are therefore looking for a dedicated and hands-on Tax Manager to be based at Clipper’s headquarters in Copenhagen.

Today, tax matters at Clipper are handled across Finance, Legal and external advisors. With increasing regulatory complexity and risk exposure, we are establishing a more formalized and proactive tax function. The Tax Manager will play a key role in building this capability and embedding robust tax governance across the organization.

You will report directly to the CFO and work closely with the Head of Legal & Corporate Affairs and Head of Controlling and external advisors.

What will be your responsibilities

You will be responsible for both strategic and operational tax matters across Clipper’s global activities. Your responsibilities will include, but are not limited to:

• Establish and maintain Clipper’s tax governance framework, including a tax risk register and clear processes for identifying, assessing and managing tax risks.

• Review the tax implications of material transactions and challenge tax positions and advice from external advisors where relevant.

• Own and oversee transfer pricing policies, intercompany agreements, benchmarking and documentation.

• Monitor and manage cross-border tax matters, including withholding tax, freight tax and permanent establishment risks.

• Oversee compliance with Danish tonnage tax requirements, including calculations, documentation and relevant controls.

• Coordinate corporate tax, VAT and employment tax compliance and reporting across jurisdictions, ensuring timely filings and robust documentation.

• Advise on tax matters related to international employee mobility and contractor arrangements.

• Monitor relevant tax and regulatory developments, including OECD Pillar Two and environmental and emissions-related taxes, and assess their impact on Clipper.

• Act as Clipper’s internal tax expert and trusted sparring partner, advising management on tax implications of strategic and operational decisions.

What we are looking for

At Clipper, our employees shape our work environment, so bringing a positive attitude is essential.

• We imagine that you have a relevant educational background within finance, tax, business administration, law or similar, combined with solid experience in corporate and international tax.

• You have hands-on experience with tax governance and tax risk management, combined with strong knowledge of transfer pricing, cross-border taxation and international tax principles.

• You are comfortable working with external advisors while also challenging and validating tax positions when needed.

• You are structured and analytical, but also pragmatic and commercially minded.

• You enjoy taking ownership, working independently and turning complex tax matters into practical advice and solutions for the business.

• You communicate confidently across functions and levels of the organisation and are fluent in both Danish and English.

• Shipping experience, including knowledge of tonnage tax or other shipping-specific tax matters, is an advantage, but not a requirement.

Don’t meet every single requirement?

If you’re enthusiastic about this role but your experience doesn’t align perfectly with each qualification, we still encourage you to apply. You could be the ideal candidate for this position, or for another opportunity with us.

What you will love about us

At Clipper, you will become part of a growing and professional work environment where we strive to be the best. We offer:

• A key role with significant influence on Clipper Bulk's tax framework and risk profile

• The opportunity to build and shape an internal tax function

• Close collaboration with senior management and exposure to strategic decision-making

• A welcoming and inclusive work environment with a variety of socal, sports, and cultural events throughout the year

• Attractive employee benefits, including pension, health, dental and critical ilness insurance

• Beautiful office facilities in Nordhavn, located near the metro with on-site paring, delicious lunch arangement and access to fitness facilities and a personal trainer.

Application and recruitment process

Please submit your CV and cover letter through our application portal by 22nd November 2026.

Applications will be reviewed on an ongoing basis and interviews will be treated with full discretion.

The recruitment process consist of two interview rounds. Shortlisted candidates will be invited to a first interview, while candidates progressing to the second round will be asked to complete a personality assessment beforehand. Confidential reference checks will be conducted for final candidates.

Learn more about Clipper at clipper-bulk.com, LinkedIn, and Instagram.

Clipper is an industry leader in dry bulk, an operator, a pool manager, and a specialist in steel services. We operate a modern fleet of approximately 120 handysize and supramax vessels, transporting a wide range of cargo from dry bulk to break bulk. Clipper is commercially headquartered in Copenhagen and employs a staff of around 100 onshore worldwide__. We are a global workplace built on five shared values: Dependable, Curious, Collaboration, Hands-on and Family. We believe in learning from one another and welcome people with a growth mindset and ambition.

Sustainability initiatives - we strive to make a positive impact. As a maritime player with a global presence at sea and onshore, we recognize our social, environmental, and ethical responsibility. We push for positive development by responsibly running our business and promoting sustainable business behavior in our network. Read more about sustainability initiatives on our website_.

IST is looking for an experienced Development Manager who thrives at the intersection of technology, people, and delivery and who is ready to lead and evolve our development organization to the next level.

At IST, we’re not just building software—we’re shaping the future of education. Our digital tools connect schools, teachers, students, and families in smarter, more meaningful ways. With over five million users across Europe, our mission is clear: to make learning easier, more engaging, and more impactful for everyone.

Joining IST means working in an international, collaborative environment where your leadership and ideas make a real difference. You’ll guide and inspire development teams, influence technical direction, and contribute to products used by thousands of schools—while growing alongside experienced colleagues who are passionate about improving education.

Role overview

We are looking for a Development Manager who is passionate about people, software development and building high-performing engineering teams. In this role, you will lead and support a few development teams while working closely with Product Owners, Architects and other stakeholders to create high-quality software solutions.

As a Development Manager, your primary focus will be leadership, team development, delivery and creating an environment where engineers can thrive and do their best work. We also believe you are curious about emerging technologies and interested in how AI can support software development, collaboration and innovation.

Key responsibilities

• Lead, coach and support some development teams

• Foster a collaborative, inclusive and high-performing engineering culture

• Support team members in their professional growth and development

• Ensure effective ways of working, agile processes and continuous improvement

• Collaborate with Product Owners and other stakeholders to align priorities and deliveries

• Drive recruitment, onboarding and team development activities

• Help teams remove obstacles and improve delivery capabilities

• Follow up on team goals, performance, engagement and work environment

• Encourage experimentation and learning around new technologies, including AI-driven tools and workflows

Role qualifications

We believe you have the following experience, capabilities and personal skills to succeed in this role:

• A bachelor's degree in computer science, software engineering or related field

• Previous experience in a leadership role within software development

• A background in software engineering or technical product development

• Strong communication and collaboration skills

• Experience working with agile development methodologies

• The ability to balance people management with business and delivery needs

• A coaching and supportive leadership style

• An interest in AI and how new technologies can improve the way teams work and deliver software

• Fluent English communication skills, both written and spoken

What we offer

This is a full-time, permanent position. At IST, we apply an office-first policy, meaning we primarily work from the office as we believe physical presence fosters collaboration, innovation, and a strong team spirit. At the same time, we understand the importance of flexibility—if you live farther away, working from the office three days a week with the remaining time remote may be possible. In Scandinavia our offices are located in Stockholm, Växjö, Roskilde and Oslo.

jobs.occupation: BM-Gulvservice ApS is hiring a Floor Layer with Mechanical Skills
jobs.description:
BM-Gulvservice ApS is looking for a motivated Floor Layer to join our team working with the installation, renovation and finishing of wooden floors.

Your primary responsibility will be practical flooring work at customer sites. We are particularly interested in applicants with good mechanical understanding who can also help maintain our equipment, identify faults and carry out minor mechanical repairs when needed.

Job title: Floor Layer
DISCO-08 code: 712200

YOUR RESPONSIBILITIES

• 
Measure and prepare work areas and subfloors.

• 
Cut, fit and install wooden flooring.

• 
Sand and renovate existing wooden floors.

• 
Prepare surfaces and apply finishing treatments.

• 
Check the quality of completed work, including joints, levels and surface finish.

• 
Operate flooring machinery and carry out routine equipment checks and maintenance.

• 
Identify common mechanical faults and perform minor repairs or adjustments at customer sites, within your competence and according to manufacturer instructions.

• 
Report faults requiring specialist repair and keep tools and equipment in good working condition.

YOUR PROFILE

We are looking for someone who:

• 
Has a practical or technical background and an interest in quality flooring work.

• 
Works accurately with measurements, materials and tools.

• 
Has good mechanical understanding and practical skills in equipment maintenance and minor repairs.

• 
Can approach mechanical problems systematically and recognise when specialist assistance is required.

• 
Is reliable, takes responsibility and works well with colleagues.

• 
Can communicate in English and understand work and safety instructions.

Previous experience with wooden flooring is an advantage. Relevant technical training and practical skills gained in another field will also be considered.

Training in our flooring methods and familiarisation with our specific equipment will be provided according to your background.

WE OFFER

• 
A full-time position primarily focused on wooden flooring.

• 
Varied installation and renovation projects at customer sites.

• 
The opportunity to use and develop both flooring and mechanical skills.

• 
Cooperation with experienced colleagues.

• 
Salary according to qualifications and employment conditions consistent with Danish standards.

HOW TO APPLY

We welcome applications from candidates in Denmark and abroad.

Please send your CV, relevant certificates and a short application in English using the contact details provided in this advertisement.

Describe your practical background and any experience with flooring, tools, machinery maintenance or repairs.

Start date by agreement, subject to any required work authorisation.

jobs.occupation: Better Nitrogen efficiency by improving Cow Resilience, Eating Dynamics, Breeding and Lifetime Efficiency
jobs.employer_name: Center for Kvantitativ Genetik og Genomforskning
jobs.description:
Applicants are invited for a PhD fellowship/scholarship at Graduate School of Technical Sciences, Aarhus University, Denmark, within the Quantitative Genetics and Genomics programme. The position is available from 1 March 2027 or later. You can submit your application via the link under 'how to apply'.

Title
Better Nitrogen efficiency by improving Cow Resilience, Eating Dynamics, Breeding and Lifetime Efficiency

Research area and project description
The Center for Quantitative Genetics and Genomics (QGG) holds a leading position in cattle breeding research, particularly in genetic studies on data generated by advanced phenotyping technologies such as the CFIT 3D camera system through industry collaboration with VikingGenetics. This state-of-the-art system enables large-scale, non-invasive measurement of feed intake, body weight, and milk production data in over 30,000 cows directly in their production environment. This PhD project will leverage this extensive phenotypic dataset generated by CFIT, in combination with feeding parameters and other phenotypes from the Danish Cattle Database, to develop genetic tools aimed at enhancing nitrogen efficiency, resilience, eating dynamics and feed efficiency. The goal is to develop novel genomic breeding values for nitrogen efficiency, while considering other important breeding goal traits (e.g., productivity, health, fertility) and other traits, such as resilience, eating dynamics and feed efficiency. The project will apply advanced statistical methods, artificial intelligence, and cutting-edge genetic models to support and enhance management and breeding decision-making by dairy farmers. This project offers a unique opportunity to contribute to the green transition in agriculture by breeding cows that are both more sustainable and economically viable for the future of Danish dairy farming. We encourage candidates finishing their MSc in summer 2027 also to apply.

Qualifications and specific competences
A relevant master’s degree (120 ECTS) in Animal Breeding
Experience with data handling softwares (e.g., R, SAS, Python, Unix Shell) and genetic softwares (e.g., DMU, BLUPF90, AIREML).
Background in working with Livestock data is an advantage.
The ability to speak and write English fluently is a prerequisite for the applicant.
Can speak and write English fluently is a prerequisite.

Place of employment and place of work
The place of employment is Aarhus University, and the place of work is Center for Quantitative Genetics and Genomics, C.F. Møllers Allé 3, 8000 Aarhus C., Denmark.

Contacts
Applicants seeking further information regarding the PhD position are invited to contact:
• Associate Professor Bingjie Li, e-mail: bingjie.li@qgg.au.dk (main supervisor)
• Tenure Track Assistant Professor Rasmus Bak Stephansen, e-mail: rasmus.stephansen@qgg.au.dk (co-supervisor)For information about application requirements and mandatory attachments, please see our application guide. If answers cannot be found there, please contact:
• admission.gradschool.tech@au.dk 
How to apply
Please follow this link to submit your application.

Application deadline is 29 November 2026 23:59 CET.

Preferred starting date is 01 March 2027.

For technical reasons, you must upload a project description. Please copy the project description above and upload it as a PDF in the application.

Please note:

• The programme committee may request further information or invite the applicant to attend an interview.
• Shortlisting will be used, which means that the evaluation committee only will evaluate the most relevant applications.
Formalities and salary range
Salary and terms as agreed between the Danish Ministry of Taxation and the Confederation of Professional Unions. You will be employed as an academic staff member at basic salary grades 4–8. As a PhD fellow you will also receive a monthly non-pensionable allowance.

Aarhus University’s ambition is to be an attractive and inspiring workplace for all and to foster a culture in which each individual has opportunities to thrive, achieve and develop. We view equality and diversity as assets, and we welcome all applicants.
